documents.title: TELMISARTAN TABLET — Angioedema
documents.text:
DailyMed — TELMISARTAN TABLET (NDA 021162)

WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS
6.1 Angioedema
Telmisartan can cause angioedema. In controlled trials, angioedema occurred in 0.2% of patients
treated with telmisartan and 0.1% of patients treated with placebo. Angioedema has also been
reported in postmarketing experience. Patients with a history of angioedema while receiving another
angiotensin II receptor blocker should not be treated with telmisartan.

documents.title: Angioedema with telmisartan: a population-based cohort study
documents.text:
PubMed — PMID 35221409 — "Angioedema with telmisartan: a population-based cohort study"
(British Journal of Clinical Pharmacology, 2022).

METHODS: We followed 128,442 adults who started telmisartan or another antihypertensive.
RESULTS: Current telmisartan use was associated with angioedema (adjusted hazard ratio 1.38,
95% CI 1.12-1.70) within the first 90 days of therapy. Risk was higher in adults with a prior
history of angioedema.
CONCLUSIONS: In adults, telmisartan use was associated with an increased rate of angioedema.
